description: Finds the published Life Scenario "What to say" guide for parents that best matches a topic (for example: "nobody will play with me", "being teased") and returns its short answer, the key lines a child can say, its URL and, when the guide has one, a practice_url: a practice scenario on a similar situation that the adult can open with the child without signing up. If no guide on that topic is published, returns status "no_article_yet" and, when a public practice scenario is about the same situation, that scenario. Topics involving risk of harm, or medical or legal questions, return status "not_covered" with no guide or practice link.

topic.description: The topic or the words the child used, e.g. "left out at recess".

name: get_what_to_say

outputSchema.description: One of three shapes. A published guide: title, url, short_answer, key_scripts and, when available, practice_url (no status field). No guide on the topic: status "no_article_yet" with guides_hub and, when a public practice scenario is about the same situation, nearest_practice_situation. Topic not covered: status "not_covered" with topic_area and note, and no link.

guides_hub.description: The list of all published guides. Present with status no_article_yet.

key_scripts.description: Lines a child can say, at most 8.

match_quality.description: Present with a guide, and with nearest_practice_situation.

more_at.description: The guide's page, which has all of its lines. Present only when the guide has more than 8.

nearest_practice_situation.description: A public practice scenario about the same situation. Present only with status no_article_yet, and only when one fits closely.

age_note.description: Present when the scenario is not written for the age that was asked about.

ages.description: Ages the scenario is written for, e.g. "8–14".

play_url.description: Opens the scenario without an account.

scenario_page_url.description: Published page for parents about this situation, when there is one.

situation.description: Short excerpt of the scenario text.

what_to_say_guide_url.description: Published what-to-say guide that uses this scenario, when there is one.

practice_note.description: What the practice link is, and the ages the scenario is written for when narrower than the guide's.

practice_url.description: A practice scenario on a similar situation; opens without an account. Present only when the guide has one.

reviewed_by.description: Name and credentials of the guide's reviewer. Present only when the guide has a named reviewer.

status.description: Absent when a guide is returned.

topic_area.description: With status not_covered: the kind of topic that was recognised.

urgent_help.description: Where to get urgent help: the wording of the guide's own section of that name, or, with status not_covered, the same published wording for topics involving risk of harm.

title: Get a what-to-say guide
